title: Icebreaker Controller Config
description: Phase 6 Scope B: top-level additionalProperties: true so a future config with a new section still loads on an older daemon (rollback insurance / Confluent FULL compatibility). Each section still uses additionalProperties: false to catch key typos in known sections. `x-reload: hot|restart` is a custom extension: `hot` = daemon can pick up the new value on next turn; `restart` = requires `systemctl restart icebreaker-controller`. GUI reads this to switch between Adw.Toast (transient) and Adw.Banner (sticky).

fallback_chain.description: v6.65: ordered list of QB backends to try after the primary fails on transport/API error. Skipped on schema-validation failures (those are prompt issues that retrying the same backend won't fix). Empty = current behavior (no fallback).

timeout_seconds.description: Decision timeout in seconds — auto-deny on expiry.

presenter.description: HITL approval presenter. 'terminal' (default), 'screen_reader' (a11y), 'gtk' (GUI, requires PyGObject), 'ai_terminal' (Textual TUI).

trust_ttl_seconds.description: Trust grant lifetime in seconds. 0 = disabled (default).

catalogue_path.description: Path to the model catalogue (catalogue.toml). Defaults to the in-repo file alongside the controller code.

model_search_dirs.description: Ordered list of directories the ModelRegistry searches for installed GGUF files. First match wins.

read_roots.description: F-28: extra absolute-path read roots passed to mcpd via MCPD_FS_READ_ROOTS. Landlock + validate() honour these on top of STATIC_ROOTS + $HOME.

mcpd_binary.description: Path to the mcpd binary (relative to repo root or absolute).

audit_log.description: Path to the append-only audit log (INV-8). Supports ~/ expansion.

pb_endpoint.description: HTTP endpoint for the Privileged Brain llama-server, or `unix://<path>` for AF_UNIX socket.

pb_model_id.description: Model ID for PB (used in audit rows). Match a `catalogue.toml` entry.

qb_max_retries.description: Retry count on QB call failure (schema violation, provider error) before falling through to fallback_chain.

mcpd_schemas_dir.description: Directory containing mcpd tool JSON schemas. Empty = auto-detect from mcpd_binary.

pb_transport.description: Transport for PB llama-server. 'http' = TCP loopback; 'unix' = AF_UNIX socket.

turn_timeout_seconds.description: Client-side timeout for a single `turn.run` RPC. Raise for slow-emulation guests (Rosetta 2 running PB Qwen 1.5B); native x86-64 / arm64 completes in seconds. F-25 rationale.

model_probe_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout (seconds) for hardware probe subprocess calls (sysctl / nvidia-smi / rocm-smi). Raise on slow VM disks or encrypted rootfs.

tier0_fast_path.description: v6.8 M7.2: skip PB grammar-decode for Tier 0 read-only intents whose intent -> tool_call mapping is deterministic (fs.list/read/stat, system.status/cpu/memory/disk/uptime, process.list/inspect, service.logs, network.status/dns.read, package.query). Removes a ~1-2s round-trip per read-only turn. INV-2 schema validation still runs on the constructed tool_call before mcpd dispatch. Set false to force every intent through PB.

session.description: REPL session and UX parameters. All optional.

max_turns.description: Maximum turns before session auto-closes (P2-F20 memory bound).

history_path.description: Path to readline history file. Supports ~/ expansion.

ephemeral_history.description: True = in-memory only (SF-8 safe default); false = file-based readline history.

show_spinner.description: Show live braille spinner while QB/PB/mcpd process.

show_progress.description: Show step-by-step pipeline progress instead of generic spinner.

stream_output.description: Stream QB summarisation tokens as they arrive.

color.description: ANSI colour output. 'auto' enables when stdout is a TTY.

prompt_prefix.description: Prefix shown in the REPL prompt: `(N) [backend] prefix > `.

max_tool_output_lines.description: Lines of tool output forwarded to QB for summarisation.

max_shell_context_chars.description: Per-field cap on shell context values (cwd, active_window, recent commands) rendered into the <context> preamble. Larger = QB sees richer environment; smaller = tighter INV-2 blast radius on prompt injection through untrusted shell state.

max_recent_commands.description: Number of most-recent shell commands included in the <context> preamble. QB uses these to resolve references like 'the file I was editing'.

recent_turns_count.description: v6.9 Task #149: number of prior (user query, tool result summary) pairs shown to QB so pronouns like 'it' or 'that' resolve against earlier turns. 0 disables the feature. Bounded low to control prompt cost.

recent_turns_max_chars.description: v6.9 Task #149: cap the total rendered recent_turns block. Per-line values are already capped at 200 chars via the _clean() sanitizer; this bounds the section as a whole.

keymap.description: HITL approval-gate key bindings. All optional — defaults to numeric + mnemonic + universal bindings. Each value is an array of single-character strings.

deny.description: Keys that trigger DENY. Default: ["2", "d", "n"]. Esc is always DENY regardless.

trust.description: Keys that trigger TRUST. Default: ["5", "t"]. Disabled when trust_ttl_seconds = 0.

help.description: Keys that trigger HELP. Default: ["?"]. '?' must always be included.

undo.description: Undo scaffold — BP-2 off by default. Awaits mcpd rollback RPC.

enabled.description: Enable undo history tracking and /undo REPL command.

max_history.description: Ring buffer depth for undo history per session.

verifier.description: QB-verifier voting. Default votes=1 preserves current single-call behavior (BP-2).

votes.description: Number of independent QB verification calls. 1 = current behavior.

require.description: Exact threshold of 'verified: true' votes required. 0 = majority (ceil(votes/2)).

parallel.description: Run votes in parallel via ThreadPoolExecutor. Default true.

retry_mode.description: F-49: how aggressively to retry when the verifier rejects an intent. off = never; on_call_failed_only = retry only if reason contains 'verifier call failed' (F-44 default); on_any_rejection = retry once on any verified=false; skip_tier_01 = bypass verifier entirely for Tier 0/1 intents (fastest, drops defense-in-depth for auto-execute tiers).

tier_floor.description: v6.8 M7.1: skip verification when the classified tier is below this floor. Default 2 = skip Tier 0/1 (they cannot mutate state; sandbox-contained). Set to 0 to always verify. Set to 4 to never verify (not recommended).

agent_graph.description: v6.8 Task #146: LangGraph runtime orchestration. OFF by default in v6.9 — responder_node stub (Task #151 pending) returns empty TurnResult.output. Flip on once Task #151 wires token streaming + summarization.

enabled.description: Route run_turn_streaming through AgentGraph.run() instead of the monolithic pipeline. Default false. Flip after Task #151 wires responder output — otherwise TurnResult.output is empty.

checkpointer_path.description: SQLite checkpoint DB path for durable execution. Uses tilde-expansion. XDG-compliant default under ~/.local/state/. File chmod 0600.

checkpointer_retention_days.description: Prune checkpoint rows older than N days on daemon startup. 30 default; SQLite DB stays small at 100 turns/day.

strict_msgpack.description: CVE mitigation (§13.1 SQLi->RCE). True = restrict checkpoint deserialization to a built-in safe set + Icebreaker allowlist. Never disable in production.

daemon.description: Daemon mode — opt-in persistent background service. BP-2: absent = monolithic mode.

max_connections.description: Maximum concurrent client connections. Architecture supports N; default 1.

socket_group.description: Unix group ownership on the daemon socket. Members of this group can connect. Empty = leave the group untouched at the OS default.

reader_recv_timeout_seconds.description: Poll interval (seconds) for the client reader loop's socket.recv. Smaller = lower response latency on notifications; larger = less CPU. 1 s is the historical default.

max_reconnect_delay_seconds.description: Cap for exponential-backoff reconnect delay when the daemon socket drops. Starts at 1 s, doubles until this cap. Lower = quicker reconnect after outage; higher = less busy-wait pressure during long outages.

prompts.description: System prompt file locations. All optional — defaults to the in-package controller/prompts/ directory.

prompts_dir.description: Directory containing prompt .txt files. Empty = in-package default. Phase 6: set to /etc/icebreaker/prompts.

qb_local.description: Override path for qb_local.txt. Empty = use prompts_dir.

qb_anthropic.description: Override path for qb_anthropic.txt. Empty = use prompts_dir.

qb_gemini.description: Override path for qb_gemini.txt. Empty = use prompts_dir.

qb_openai.description: Override path for qb_openai.txt. Empty = use prompts_dir.

pb.description: Override path for pb.txt. Empty = use prompts_dir.

qb_verifier.description: Override path for qb_verifier.txt. Empty = use prompts_dir.

cost.description: Per-session cost governance (SF-9, BP-10). 0 ceiling = unlimited.

session_ceiling_usd.description: Deny turns once session cost reaches this USD amount. 0 = no limit.

warn_fraction.description: Alert user at this fraction of the session ceiling.

limits.description: Resource limits — input cap + rate limiting (SF-9, BP-10).

max_input_chars.description: Reject inputs larger than this char count. 0 = no limit.

max_turns_per_min.description: Rate limit turns per minute. 0 = unlimited.

terminal.description: AI Terminal TUI settings (Phase 6T). All optional — defaults to OLED dark, top input, # prefix.

cot_scrollback.description: Number of CoT traces to keep in scrollback.

nl_prefix.description: Character that triggers NL mode at column 0. Default '#'.

show_tier_badge.description: Show tier classification badge in interpretation view.

show_suggestions.description: Show actionable suggestions after turn completion.

tier2.description: Tier-2 independent review. Off by default (BP-2).

enabled.description: Enable Tier-2 review for high-risk operations.

strategy.description: Review strategy. 'llm' uses QB as reviewer.

max_retries.description: Max retry attempts on Tier-2 review failure.

desktop.description: Desktop GUI configuration (Phase 6UI). Controls GTK4 window behavior.

start_tray.description: Start minimized to system tray. BP-2: off by default.

chatbot_on_tray.description: Open chatbot window when tray icon is clicked.

default_window.description: Default window to open. Default: chatbot.

prefer_app_api.description: Prefer D-Bus app APIs over generic AT-SPI.

a11y_timeout_ms.description: Timeout for AT-SPI tree queries in milliseconds.

rpa.description: RPA Bridge configuration (Phase 6T). Off by default (BP-2).

enabled.description: Enable RPA escalation from GUI Agent failures.

timeout_seconds.description: Hard timeout for RPA workflows in seconds.

model_id.description: Catalogue key (looked up in catalogue.toml). The Controller never sees the on-disk filename — resolved via the model registry.

draft_model_id.description: Optional speculative-decoding draft. Must reference a catalogue entry with role='draft'.

transport.description: Transport for llama-server. 'http' today; 'unix' reserved for Phase 6 distro packaging.
